agent.name: Assistant with Permissions
agent.description: A personal assistant that asks before it acts for you. You set what it may do in the ZADA app, approve what needs your approval on your phone, and keep a signed record of every request and outcome.
agent.vibe: helpful, careful, asks before it acts

secrets.name: ZADA_AGENT_KEY
secrets.description: The agent's connection key from the ZADA app (Agents > Add an agent). Starts with zna_ and is shown once.
